name: InferHub Claude Code (LiteLLM) for macOS
purpose: One double-click on a Mac: bootstrap, start local LiteLLM, pick folder and InferHub seats, run Claude Code
title: Claude Code via InferHub + local LiteLLM (macOS single entry point)

deploy_mirrors.label: Mac ACS checkout
deploy_mirrors.notes: Run from a git checkout of ACS (git pull to update) or via the raw-URL one-liner in README.md. No separate mirror copy.

source_paths: Desktop deploy mirror launch-claude-inferhub.ps1 (2026-10-02, newer than v0.2.0; see NOTES.md)

files.notes: Single entry point; bash 3.2; bootstraps tools, starts LiteLLM, pickers, execs claude
Windows parity, differences, secrets, test evidence
Mock claude + real local LiteLLM on a non-4000 port

secrets_policy.repo_rule: The launcher reads keys from files at runtime, prompts with hidden input, writes mode 600, never prints values.

dependencies: Pukujan/litellm-ckff-ops main (includes #34 startup fix and #37 seat fallbacks); cloned to ~/work/litellm-ckff-ops when absent (private: needs GitHub auth)
Installed on demand: uv, Python 3.12 (uv-managed), litellm[proxy]==1.103.0, Claude Code (native installer; npm fallback)
summary: Mac port of inferhub-litellm. Same Top 20 model table and defaults, same seat aliases and fallback chains (the workbench's own Python scripts run unchanged), same ANTHROPIC_* environment and env clearing, claude --model sonnet --permission-mode bypassPermissions. Not yet run on a real Mac.
